{{Otheruses|Outrider}}
'''Outrider Shipping''' was a front company used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Supplies being shipped across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] would be marked as "Outrider Shipping" for ease of identification by Alliance [[operative]]s.
